avis.texte: I have been using the face wash for at least 7 years so keep that in mind when reading my review. I had terrible skin through my youth. I am now 35. I get the occasional hormonal breakouts but it kills them like a champ. Every other or three days I wash my face. Best combo in the world hands down.

I seriously look forward to it. My skin feels great after washing, never tight or dry. THE BAD: It doesn't remove makeup very well. I don't wear a ton, I use makeup remover around my eyes beforehand, but when using a toner after washing there is still a lot of makeup that is left on the cotton ball. So, I would recommend a double cleanse when removing makeup for the day. I also did not see any difference in the advertised brightening effect. But, as I mentioned, I only have used the travel size, so if it takes more than that amount to see brightening, you'll have to get the bigger size. I know Vitamin C takes a while to lighten dark spots, so I just can't say if this cleanser works for that or not. THE UGLY: The price for what you get. I bought this during a B1G1 mini size sale to try it out. Based on what I've experienced, I would never pay full price for this product. I would definitely use it again as a morning cleanser if the price was right, but I think there are cheaper options out there that are just as good.
